data.name: Neon City Legends
data.detailed_description:
THIS CITY IS YOURS.

A new city is generated every run - districts, traffic, crews, and trouble
included. How you make your name in it is up to you.

SAVE IT - OR TAKE IT.

Every action feeds MERIT or INFAMY. Stop a mugging and the block remembers;
finish the mugging yourself and the sirens do. A 12-mission branching story
locks in your path: clean the streets with Detective Reyes, or climb the
Vireo Syndicate under Vex.

FIGHT LIKE YOU MEAN IT

Real combat, or button mash: combo chains, high kicks that launch,
directional blocks and perfect-block counters, dodge rolls, and a full clinch game: grab, knee, punch, and the judo whiplash throw that sends people across the street. Attacks go where you face, so it plays
as well on a pad as a mouse. Train at the dojo, earn belts from five
masters, and test it all in THE PIT, an underground wave-survival fight club
where you walk with the pot… or risk it on one more round.

DRIFT. RACE. WRECK.

120 car models across four rarity tiers haunt the traffic pool - log them,
hunt the six legendaries, store your keepers in the garage. Race checkpoint
circuits against rivals running the same drift physics you do. Cars catch
fire, cook off, and blow debris across the intersection. Rain slicks the
roads; the radio plays original or upload your own.

OWN THE BLOCK

  • Territory - 16 districts. Wipe the turf crew, survive the
    retaliation, collect the income.
  • Gang wars - four named crews brawl over unclaimed blocks with or
    without you. Pick a side for a cut, or break it up for merit.
  • Businesses & safehouses - from a laundromat to a nightclub;
    owned districts pay 1.5×. Buy a pad, set your respawn, swap your look.

SCORE-ATTACK STATIONS

Twelve neon challenge terminals scattered through the city - DRIFT TRIAL,
SPRINT, MAYHEM (with a loaned SMG and arcade power-ups: STAR, RAPID, MEGA,
TURBO) and SURVIVAL against the district crew and its boss. Bronze, silver
and gold medals pay cash, XP and gear; gold every station of a type and the
city hands you something legendary. Instant retry - that one-more-try
feeling, no walk back.

THE ARCADE

Real playable cabinets inside the city's businesses, each a fictional
franchise with its own high-score board: STREET SERPENT II, RAT ATTACK '89,
NEON SMASH TURBO, BLOCK BUSTER 2099 - and a rare prototype hidden somewhere
in town. Own the arcade and every cabinet in the city is free play. Beat
the house #1 and it pays out.

HEAT

A five-star wanted system that escalates for real: foot patrols, pursuit
cruisers, SWAT vans, spike-strip roadblocks - and at five stars, the police
helicopter with a searchlight and a door gunner. It's shootable. Good luck.

MODDING LAB

The game ships with the tool: turn your art into playable
characters, import your own soundtrack, import/export new characters.

AND THE REST

  • 28 trackable challenges and three daily contracts with streak bonuses
  • Full character creator: builds, heights, outfits, hairstyles, faces
  • Full controller support, including menus
  • Procedural chiptune radio + original soundtrack

data.short_description: Save the city or take it. Fight like you mean it - grapples, throws and knockouts. Drift, race, wreck. Own the block. Chase medals at score-attack stations, hunt arcade high scores, and become a legend in a neon pixel city that's different every run.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual-core 2GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or later (Apple Silicon only)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple Silicon integrated GPU
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent cartoon-style pixel violence against human characters (fists, melee weapons, firearms, vehicles), with small pixel blood effects. The player can commit fictional crimes such as theft, robbery, and assault. No gore, no sexual content, no real-world references.
